Kids Concerts for under 5s

Wigs and Wiggles

Events  /  Wigs and Wiggles
Select Sundays 10.15-11.00 & 11.30-12.15
£8 per adult £4 per child
Book now

Join us at Handel Hendrix House for an exciting new concert series for under 5s and their families, that brings the magic of Baroque music to life! Wigs and Wiggles invites children to sing, dance, and move while exploring the vibrant world of Handel’s music. Put on your favourite wig and get ready to wiggle to the sounds of the Baroque era! Suitable for children under 5.

11th October

Handel’s Housewarming

New on the London scene, Handel is having some friends over for his favourite games. Handel is ready to celebrate his first year in the big city. We’ll journey to London in 1710 with Handel, walking the historic streets and immerse ourselves in the sounds of the time. We’ll need your help hosting the best party ever! What could possibly go wrong…
